verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS platform like Brevo, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a setting to opt out of Brevo's own telemetry or usage tracking. The tracking features in the pack (custom event tracking, website activity monitoring) are tools for tracking end-users, not opt-out controls, so they do not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
